records.metric: Cumulative humans implanted with an intracortical BCI (peer-reviewed count), against the 10,000-by-2030 milestone the field has set
records.trend: A peer-reviewed count across all iBCI trials, ~150× below the 10,000-by-2030 milestone. Enrolment is now accelerating across several companies (Neuralink 21, Synchron, Precision Neuroscience). On the therapeutic side, clinical trials of brain stimulation for psychiatric conditions have doubled roughly every 4.7 years since 2000 — trial starts are among the field's costliest commitments.
